items.title: Lars Edegran Interview, 1965-09-27
items.q: I played with them there for two months... Jim Young was the leader of the band.

ctx.x: That was a band, I don't know what they called themselves but Jim Young was the leader of the band. Bass player, he once played with Keith Smith. Half of the band is Scottish, half of it is English. They played at the pub on Drury Lane in London. I played with them there for two months, three days in a week. They went up to their hometown in Edinburgh, played on weekends. I was up there with them.
Well you played quite a bit professionally in England too then.
